reuse.why: Uses the existing primitives (getSheetValue, setBudget, isTrackingBudget, batchMessages, undoable registration) but the tree has no shared category-selection helper and the diff does not create one, copying the selection instead.

duplication.why: Copies the hidden/hidden-group/template SQL filter and the income-in-tracking guard verbatim from setZero/set3MonthAvg, and restates the expense sign flip, adding another copy of the month-wide selection rule.

placement.why: The action is in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type and registration, and one test.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with neighbours, but the exclusion rules now live in one more hand-kept copy, so a future rule change must touch yet another query.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared selection abstraction exists in this tree to bypass; the existing write/sheet helpers are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The category query and income guard in setLastMonthSpending (actions.ts) are plain copies of setZero's, not disguised.
